user.title: CAME Access – Login
user.description: Enter your CAME Access cloud account credentials, the Site ID, and the SIP password. The integration will discover your XTS7/BPT unit and AUX outputs.

data.local_ip: Local IP of XTS7 unit (optional, not used for door-open)

data_description.site_id: The numeric site ID from the CAME Access web app (e.g. the number in the cameconnect.net site URL).
data_description.sip_password: The SIP password for your Mobile App slot. This is no longer returned by the cloud API, so it must be entered manually.
data_description.local_ip: Only needed if you want the device info to show a local IP. Leave empty otherwise.

pick_device.title: Select Device
pick_device.description: Multiple CAME Access units were found. Pick the one to control.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid email or password. Please check your CAME Access credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the CAME Access cloud API. Check your internet connection.
error.no_devices: No compatible XTS7/BPT units found. Make sure the CAME Access app shows the unit and the invitation has been accepted.
error.device_not_found: The selected device could not be found.
error.invalid_site_id: Site ID must be a number.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This CAME Access account is already configured.

init.title: CAME Access Options
init.description: Use 'Re-discover' to refresh SIP parameters from the cloud API (e.g. after a password change or slot reassignment).

abort.rediscovery_failed: Re-discovery failed. Check the Home Assistant logs.
abort.device_not_found: The device could not be found during re-discovery.
abort.invalid_site_id: The stored Site ID is not a valid number. Remove and re-add the integration.
